name: mode-refine
description: Post-build refinement mode for small copy/style/content adjustments without architecture changes.
content:
# Mode Refine

## Allowed
- Copy/content updates.
- Minor style/spacing/color tuning.
- Small UX polish within existing structure.

## Not Allowed
- New major sections/features.
- Layout architecture changes.
- Stack changes.
author: agentpm
